dwc_samplingProtocol: Oblique tow with a 1-m ring net (1-m mouth diameter, 0.8 m^2 mouth area) retrieved at a constant wire angle from ~140 m to the surface; volume filtered from a flowmeter, abundance standardized per 10 m^2 of sea surface by the standard haul factor.
note: L22 TOOL0988 states 1-m mouth diameter AND 0.8 m^2 opening area — the same two numbers the SWFSC lookup gives. Standard CalCOFI oblique gear before Dec 1977.

dwc_samplingProtocol: Oblique tow with a 2-m^2 mouth-area ring net (1.6-m mouth diameter).
note: No L22 concept for a 1.6-m ring net.

dwc_samplingProtocol: Oblique tow with a 71-cm bongo net (0.4 m^2 mouth area per cod end, 0.505 mm mesh) retrieved at a constant 45 degree wire angle from 210 m to the surface; volume filtered from a flowmeter, abundance standardized per 10 m^2 by the standard haul factor. Paired cod ends: one preserved in formalin for SWFSC ichthyoplankton, one for the SIO Pelagic Invertebrate Collection.
note: L22 NETT0176 'Bongo net' is the generic double-ring-mouth concept, 'with further specifications either unknown or described elsewhere in the supporting metadata' — exactly this use. Standard CalCOFI oblique gear since Dec 1977.

dwc_samplingProtocol: Vertical tow with a 0.25 m^2 mouth-area ring net; abundance standardized per unit sea-surface area.
note: No L22 concept matches a 0.25 m^2 ring net (L22's half-metre ring net is 0.196 m^2).

dwc_samplingProtocol: Oblique tow to 600 m with the CB bongo net, historically used to sample sablefish.
note: Same device as CB (L22 is a device catalogue); the 600-m depth is the protocol, not the gear.

dwc_samplingProtocol: Multiple Opening/Closing Net and Environmental Sensing System, 1 m^2 mouth area.
note: L22's MOCNESS concepts are citation-specific and do not distinguish mouth area.

dwc_samplingProtocol: Multiple Opening/Closing Net and Environmental Sensing System, 3 m^2 mouth area.
note: L22's MOCNESS concepts are citation-specific and do not distinguish mouth area.

dwc_samplingProtocol: Oblique tow with a MARMAP bongo net (2-ft mouth diameter).
note: L22's MARMAP bongo concepts are a 20-cm net and a Posgay and Marak (1980) citation; neither states the 2-ft diameter this code names.

dwc_samplingProtocol: Surface (neuston) tow with a twin-winged continuous-flow Manta net; abundance standardized per 1000 m^3 of water strained (volume, not haul factor — a Manta tow has no depth-integrated area).
Paired vertical tows of the CalCOFI vertical egg net (PairoVET), fished from ~70 m to the surface for fish eggs.
note: No L22 concept for the CalVET/PairoVET net.

dwc_samplingProtocol: Oblique tow; the CDFW Dungeness megalopae sorting log records the tow geometry but not the net.
note: A tow geometry, not a gear — the device is unrecorded, so no L22 concept can be assigned.
